audit.why: Lane difficulty is framed correctly: Cassiopeia wins levels 1-3 on poke, Aatrox owns 6 on World Ender, Cassiopeia scales back in from first item. That matches the 55.68% Emerald+ win rate over 176 games and the level chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike names World Ender but gives no cooldown and no anti-heal answer, so the advice stays vague.
audit.why: World Ender is 120/100/80s and its threat is increased healing stacked on Deathbringer Stance (P) and the Umbral Dash (E) passive heal. Grievous Wounds is the item answer and it is absent from the content layer entirely.
audit.corrected: Spike text now names the two healing sources and tells you to buy anti-heal before 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text says to hold Miasma to ground Umbral Dash but never states that the two cooldowns do not trade one-for-one.
audit.why: Umbral Dash is 9/8/7/6/5s; Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s. He gets roughly two to three dashes per grounding zone, so spending W on his first dash is the losing pattern. Infernal Chains (W) is itself a grounding pull, which is why holding Miasma for the commit is the decisive interaction.
audit.corrected: Mid text now states both cooldowns and the resulting rule: never ground the first dash.

audit.whatIsWrong: In the full layer, dosFull[2], dontsFull[1] and dontsFull[2] have bodies copy-pasted from unrelated entries — the body does not describe its own heading.
audit.why: dosFull[2] is headed 'E-spam only poisoned targets' but the body talks about Aatrox spending World Ender. dontsFull[1] is headed 'Spam E without poison' but the body is about Miasma. dontsFull[2] is headed 'Push past river without vision' but the body is a verbatim duplicate of tradeBad.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten to match its own heading.

edits.before: World Ender is his window, not yours — the combat stats plus his Q/passive healing let him drain through your poison, so respect the 6 timer and hold W Miasma to ground his E dash if he all-ins.
edits.after: World Ender is his window, not yours — combat stats plus Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash healing drain your poison, so buy anti-heal before 6 and hold Miasma to ground the E dash on his commit, not his poke.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a real fight, not a free win — extra E ranks ramp your single-target DPS, but his Q knockups and his Q/passive healing mean an even commit becomes a coinflip if you mistime W. Keep priming with Q and only E poisoned targets so your mana holds. At 6 respect him: World Ender's combat stats and heal can flip a trade you were winning, so hold W to ground his E engage and don't duel into a fresh R without your own ult available.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a real fight — extra E ranks ramp your DPS, but his Q knockups and Q/passive healing make an even commit a coinflip if you mistime W. Umbral Dash comes back every 9s and Miasma every 24s, so never ground his first dash; hold it for the one that commits. Keep priming with Q and only E poisoned targets so your mana holds. At 6, World Ender's combat stats and healing can flip a won trade — buy anti-heal and don't duel a fresh R without your own ult.

edits.before: Bait his World Ender all-in into your R Petrifying Gaze cone and let the chained Twin Fangs finish him through the heal
edits.after: Bait World Ender into your R Petrifying Gaze cone, then chain Twin Fang — with anti-heal bought his 120s ult cannot out-drain it

edits.before: Aatrox spends World Ender early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Twin Fang costs 40 mana and only pays off on a poisoned target — unprimed spam empties you.

edits.before: Miasma is your only anti-engage tool — wasting it on spacing chip leaves the dash window wide open.
edits.after: Twin Fang on an unpoisoned Aatrox is chip damage at 40 mana a cast — you go dry before he goes low.

edits.before: Spamming E without poison until your mana bar dies — and then standing in World Ender range with Miasma on cooldown.
edits.after: Aatrox has no escape, he waits on a jungler and holds Infernal Chains for the collapse — with Miasma spent, nothing stops it.

notes: Kit file flags Cassiopeia's Twin Fang (E) as a projectile blockable by Wind Wall-class effects. Riot's own description calls it an attack she 'lets loose' at a target with no travel language, so this reads like a tooltip-parse misfire; I did not assert projectile behaviour anywhere. The full layer writes 'Twin Fangs' (plural) in spikes and report text where the real name is Twin Fang — I left untouched instances alone rather than spend length budget on cosmetics.
